### McGraw Hill, Inc. to Participate in Upcoming Conference


November 11, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/964897494/files/doc_news/McGraw-Hill-Inc--to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Conference-2026.pdf)


COLUMBUS, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[McGraw Hill, Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2F&esheet=54639004&newsitemid=20261111672617&lan=en-US&anchor=McGraw+Hill%2C+Inc&index=1&md5=8edf4ab2a102abe6b491ac6aca0a20dd) . (NYSE: MH; the “Company”) today announced that Philip Moyer, President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Company’s Board of Directors, will attend the BMO Technology & Innovation Leaders Conference and participate in a fireside chat scheduled on Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 9:35 AM ET.


The fireside chat will be available via webcast on[McGraw Hill, Inc. - Investor Relations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.mheducation.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54639004&newsitemid=20261111672617&lan=en-US&anchor=McGraw+Hill%2C+Inc.+-+Investor+Relations&index=2&md5=9b86e76e68f30d4f274b8b14d0ee9a81) along with a replay thereof.


**McGraw Hill, Inc.**


McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE: MH) is a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, supporting the evolving needs of millions of educators and students around the world. We provide trusted, high-quality content and personalized learning experiences that use data, technology and learning science to help students progress towards their goals. Through our commitment to fostering a culture of innovation and belonging, we are dedicated to improving outcomes and access to education for all. We have over 30 offices across North America, Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East and South America, and make our learning solutions available in more than 80 languages. Visit us at[mheducation.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2F&esheet=54639004&newsitemid=20261111672617&lan=en-US&anchor=mheducation.com&index=3&md5=57d217599d95b826ccf47f84586a0527) or find us on[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fmcgrawhilleducation&esheet=54639004&newsitemid=20261111672617&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=4&md5=2041e42a403be9a79270773141690d72) ,[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fmheducation%2F%3Fhl%3Den&esheet=54639004&newsitemid=20261111672617&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=5&md5=0ece0569fb3602ad5845fed069babf14) ,[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fmcgraw-hill-education%2F&esheet=54639004&newsitemid=20261111672617&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=6&md5=96aec63d82cb82b6c2562fb215c3be49) or[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fmheducation&esheet=54639004&newsitemid=20261111672617&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=7&md5=c2d6477612ff3e9da210681d7a165472) .
